notes: Summary: evaluation for repository-aware IDE copilot + low-latency code completion. Primary constraint = EU residency + VPC/offline option.
Product fit: want embeddings-driven retrieval per-repo with commit-aware indexing (update on push). Vector DB must be co-located in customer VPC or on-prem node.
Latency target: interactive IDE suggestions — time-to-first-token ideally <75ms; sustained suggestion throughput during code scanning and multi-file search.
Chunking preference: file-aware chunking (prefer preserving code tokens / symbol boundaries), ~400-800 token chunks, overlap 50-100 tokens for context continuity.
Embedding cadence: incremental updates on Git push; support for per-branch indexes and quick reindexing of changed files only.

Model requirements: ability to pin model versions for deterministic behavior across releases; prefer M-1.2 (code-optimized) for completions, fallback to small quantized local model for offline/air-gap.
Streaming + UX: streaming token-by-token responses into IDE (VS Code plugin) with deterministic prefix caching to avoid rehydrating long prefixes per keystroke.
Quality controls: reranking layer to prefer repo-local docs, synthetic negative sampling for common false positives, ability to attach provenance (file path + commit sha) to returned snippets.
Security: strict EU data residency required, KMS integration mandatory, audit logs for all inference requests, retention controls configurable per index.
Cost sensitivity: want Redwood Optimize recommendations to balance batching vs. latency; interested in per-route token accounting for IDE vs. batch search traffic.
Quote from CTO (Anna L.): 'No cross-border replicas. EU-only storage or we walk away. Also need deterministic completions for our tests.'

Technical ask from Eng Lead (J. Patel): POC should include 5 repos (microservices frontend/backend + infra) ~2M LOC, measure median time-to-first-token and 95th latency; measure cost per 1k completions and embedding update cadence.
POC constraints: one-week smoke, then 6-week pilot. Pilot must demonstrate automatic incremental re-indexing and <2s full-reindex for <200 changed files.
Preferred deployment: private control plane with customer-managed VPC, optional on-prem worker for air-gapped teams; dedicated GPUs for model pinning and predictable latency.
Sales note: receptive to annual reserved capacity if latency SLOs proven; legal wants SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence; security asked for HSM/KMS diagrams.
Misc stubs: Drive pricing deck linked; Fireflies transcript exists for demo call; Jira tickets opened for infra questions.
